name: Borussia Dortmund GmbH & Co. Kommanditgesellschaft auf Aktien
summary: Borussia Dortmund GmbH & Co. Kommanditgesellschaft auf Aktien, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the football business in Germany. It operates through Borussia Dortmund GmbH & Co. KGaA, BVB Merchandising GmbH, and BVB Event & Catering GmbH segments. The company operates a professional football club; and markets the Signal Iduna Park, a football stadium. It also offers TV marketing, advertising, match operations, transfer deal, merchandising, conference, catering, and other services.
